title: SEC0: open() called while holding pool mutex in pool_release
description: crypto2dev_port.c lines 421-429: crypto2dev_pool_release holds pool->lock across the open(CRYPTO2DEV_PATH, ...) syscall (line 424). open() is a blocking syscall that can stall if /dev/crypto2dev is under load or the kernel driver is slow. Holding the mutex during open() blocks all concurrent crypto2dev_pool_acquire calls for the duration of the open, serializing all operations behind a single blocked thread. Fix: perform the open() outside the mutex; acquire the mutex only to store the new fd and clear in_use. If the open fails outside the mutex, re-acquire and leave fd=-1 with appropriate logging (consistent with the fix for wolfssl-mp4).
